name: spot-menu
description: Spot metering at the AF target, the menu part: page 594 'Spot Metering', opened by the Custom Menu E row that data/specs/custom-menu-rows-4.json adds, with three On/Off rows: Spot (setting 593, prm 0x94D1), Spot Hilight (660, 0x9F91), Spot Shadow (621, 0x9821); MODE bank, u8, ROM and full-reset default 0 (Off); no stock code reads or writes them, and no mode-controller table but the full reset names them (bank lists, mode presets and restore lists do not: experiments/2026-11-18-look-editor/out/scan.tsv). data/specs/spot-core.json reads them. The rows use the stock texts 171, 106, 107 and the generic list pages 198, 584, 659 with the Off/On items of list 200; the On/Off value records of the settings 446, 448, 449 name the three settings. The title (and the row's label) is text 1494, the row's help 1509: unused built-in EVF texts that data/specs/card-looks-9.json points at the English texts in every menu language. No code. See experiments/2026-11-24-af-spot-metering/NOTES.md, E3, E4 and "Build spot-af".
_interface: settings 593 / 660 / 621 = prm 0x94D1 / 0x9F91 / 0x9821 (MODE bank, u8): 0 Off, 1 On
